title.narrative: The urgent response to the earthquake victims in Syria as part of the popular campaign to provide relief to those affected by the earthquake in Syria and Turkey

description.narrative: A relief plane was sent to Gaziantep in Turkey with a load of (104) tons carrying (938 food baskets, 1084 tents, 763 shelter bags, 495 blankets) and it was sent to Syria via 11 trucks
Distributing urgent relief aid to the Syrians affected by the earthquake by providing urgent food and shelter materials for 5,595 people.
Urgent response and alleviation of the suffering of the Syrians affected by the earthquake by providing urgent shelter and food materials and securing needs in light of the harsh winter conditions.
